title: Senior Quality Analyst
description:
What you’ll do

● Review requirements, user stories, and designs; identify gaps, edge cases, and acceptance criteria.

● Plan and perform functional, regression, exploratory, integration, and user acceptance testing.

● Build and maintain automated tests for critical user journeys across web and mobile.

● Test APIs and backend workflows, including request validation, responses, error handling, and data consistency.

● Test Salesforce features and workflows, including record creation and updates, permissions, automation, reports, and integrations.

● Validate end-to-end scenarios such as registration, profile and credential updates, job search, applications, recruiter interactions, and status changes.

● Verify data flows between the product, Salesforce, and connected services; investigate sync failures and duplicate or missing records.

● Track test cases, defects, and QA work in Jira; write clear, reproducible bug reports and verify fixes.

● Collaborate with developers to reproduce issues and improve testability.

● Maintain test plans, test cases, automation suites, and release quality notes.

● Participate in release readiness reviews and help the team make risk-based testing decisions.

● Consider accessibility, usability, privacy, and security in day-to-day testing.

What you’ll bring

● 3+ years of experience in software QA, including both manual and automation testing.

● Experience testing web applications and REST APIs.

● Hands-on experience with an automation framework such as Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.

● Experience with API testing tools such as Postman or equivalent.

● Salesforce testing experience, ideally with Sales Cloud or Service Cloud.

● Understanding of Salesforce objects, fields, relationships, profiles and permissions, Flows, reports, and integration behavior.

● Practical experience using Jira to manage defects, test work, and project workflows.

● Ability to write clear test scenarios and communicate defects with useful steps, expected results, and actual results.

● Familiarity with SQL or another method of validating application data.

● Understanding of the software development lifecycle, Agile practices, and CI/CD workflows.

● Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to prioritize testing based on user and business impact.

Good to have

● Experience testing mobile applications or responsive web experiences.

● Experience with healthcare, recruiting, staffing, or job marketplace products.

● Familiarity with AI-enabled features, including conversational search and recommendations.

● Experience with Salesforce integration testing, such as REST APIs, middleware, or event-driven data flows.

● Familiarity with accessibility and cross-browser testing.

Pay: ₹289,000.00 - ₹1,020,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
description:
### **Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Cloud Security Engineer** to lead the design, security, automation, and operational excellence of our cloud-native healthcare platform.

This role combines **Cloud Architecture, Platform Engineering, DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code, Security Engineering, and Healthcare Compliance** to build secure, scalable, and HIPAA-compliant systems on AWS.

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Cloud & Platform Architecture**

* Design and manage scalable, secure AWS architectures.
* Build containerized and serverless platforms using **EKS, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge, and Step Functions**.
* Lead cloud migration and modernization initiatives.
* Build automated security policy enforcement and compliance controls.
* Establish infrastructure governance and drift detection processes.

#### **DevSecOps & Infrastructure Automation**

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using **GitHub Actions**.
* Implement **Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation)**.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning, deployments, testing, security, and compliance controls.
* Drive Security-as-Code and Compliance-as-Code practices.

#### **Security & Compliance**

* Design and implement security controls using: **IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, Dependabot, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, WAF**
* Manage and Secure Kubernetes RBAC, containers, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure.
* Lead **HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2,** and healthcare security compliance initiatives.
* Conduct threat modeling, risk assessments, vulnerability management, and incident response.

#### **Application & API Security**

* Establish secure development practices for **React, Node.js, Python, REST APIs, HL7 and FHIR APIs**.
* Conduct architecture reviews and secure code assessments,
* Lead threat modeling activities.
* Implement OAuth2, OpenID Connect, RBAC, MFA, and Zero Trust principles.
* Integrate security testing into development and deployment workflows.

#### **AI & Healthcare Innovation**

* Establish security architecture for AI-enabled healthcare workflows.
* Support secure adoption of **Amazon Bedrock, RAG, AI Agents, and Healthcare AI solutions**.
* Implement Data Privacy Controls, Prompt Security, Model Access Controls, AI Governance Frameworks.
* Ensure PHI is protected within AI and GenAI workflows.

### **Required Skills**

* AWS Architecture & Security
* Terraform & CloudFormation
* Kubernetes (EKS), ECS, Docker
* GitHub Actions & CI/CD
* React, Node.js, TypeScript, Python
* PostgreSQL, Aurora, DynamoDB
* Cloud Networking & Observability
* HIPAA, SOC 2, HITRUST
* FHIR, HL7, Healthcare Interoperability
* Amazon Bedrock, RAG, AI Security

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* 8+ years in Cloud, Platform, DevSecOps, or Security Engineering.
* 5+ years designing and securing AWS production environments.
* Experience building healthcare platforms handling PHI.
* Proven expertise in Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, and DevSecOps.
* Experience implementing HIPAA and SOC 2 controls.

### **Preferred Certifications**

* AWS Solutions Architect Professional
* AWS Security Specialty
* CISSP, CCSP, HCISPP
* Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS)
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)

title: Detection & Response Engineer
description:
At TechBiz Global, we are providing recruitment service to our TOP clients from our portfolio. We are currently seeking a **Detection & Response Engineer** to join one of our clients' teams. If you're looking for an exciting opportunity to grow in a innovative environment, this could be the perfect fit for you.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Investigate security cases and targeted hunts using CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM and CQL; correlate telemetry, assess scope and impact, document findings, and recommend appropriate actions.
* Develop, test, deploy, tune, and maintain detection logic, queries, dashboards, analyst guides, and version-controlled detection content.
* Build and maintain Falcon Fusion SOAR workflows for enrichment, evidence capture, routing, escalation, and authorized response.
* Validate telemetry coverage and quality; troubleshoot parsing, normalization, mapping, and source-data issues.
* Translate validated investigations into platform workflow specifications and co-build scripts, API integrations, workflow components, and prototypes with Product and Engineering.
* Test workflows and detections against representative cases; monitor outcomes, exceptions, and production feedback, and document ownership and support handoffs.
* Provide technical support, troubleshooting, knowledge transfer, and coaching; coordinate assigned analysis and platform work.

**Must have:**

* 5+ years of relevant security experience, including at least 2 years developing, testing, and tuning detection logic, or equivalent demonstrated capability.
* Production proficiency with CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM, including CQL, cross-source investigations, detection content, telemetry interpretation, and tuning.
* Hands-on Falcon Fusion SOAR workflow experience and practical use of Charlotte AI with evidence verification and awareness of approval boundaries.
* Practical Python, REST/Falcon APIs, JSON, authentication, error handling, and secure credential management; familiarity with PowerShell or another relevant scripting language.
* Experience with telemetry onboarding, parser/normalization troubleshooting, MITRE ATT&CK, Windows/Linux events, and controlled changes, version control, peer review, and regression testing.
* Strong investigation judgment, defensible documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience converting SOC runbooks or manual analysis into production workflows or internal security platforms.
* CrowdStrike resident, responder, partner implementation, or customer-embedded Falcon experience; FalconPy or comparable API tooling.
* Experience partnering with Product and Engineering on analyst-facing features, case lifecycle integration, acceptance testing, or iterative delivery.
* Managed security services, multi-client or follow-the-sun SOC operations, and ITSM integrations such as ServiceNow or Jira.
* Relevant CrowdStrike training or credentials, GIAC invest
